## Analysis overview

Filters to ITT subjects, derives display categories, calculates descriptive statistics and category counts by treatment and total, and performs ANOVA or categorical tests for treatment comparisons.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `AGE`: age
- `SEX`: sex
- `RACE/ETHNIC`: race and ethnicity
- `MMSETOT`: baseline MMSE total score
- `DURDIS`: disease duration
- `EDUCLVL`: education level
- `WEIGHTBL/HEIGHTBL/BMIBL`: baseline weight, height, and BMI
- `TRT01P/TRT01PN`: planned treatment.
